chunks.title: Changampally 700-Year Vaidya Lineage & Founding in 1300 AD
chunks.content: The Changampally Vaidya family healing lineage in Kerala dates back to 1300 AD, spanning over seven centuries and more than 700 years of unbroken Ayurvedic medical practice. Rooted in traditional Ashtanga Hridaya wisdom, the family has served generations of patients across South India. Today, Changampally has evolved into a premier integrated healthcare institution operating 5 specialized centres across Kerala, featuring 120 hospital beds, 24/7 round-the-clock emergency medical care, and over 50 expert physicians and healthcare practitioners across 3 core disciplines (Classical Ayurveda, Modern Allopathic Medicine, and Mental & Emotional Wellbeing).

chunks.title: Core Philosophy: Integrative Medicine and Patient Safety First
chunks.content: Changampally's foundational philosophy is built on three pillars: Tradition (Panchakarma and classical formulations passed down since 1300 AD), Integration (combining Ayurvedic specialists and allopathic physicians for evidence-based care plans for intricate disorders), and Wholeness (mental and emotional wellbeing through psychiatry and psychotherapy). Chief Physician Dr. Jannathul Firdouse emphasizes: 'A person walking into your clinic should not be the reason to treat them. Treat only if you are sure that the person is safe in your hands. Safety is the first and most sacred aspect of any treatment.' Doctorhood is defined by precision in diagnosis, practical expertise, and compassionate touch rather than hollow promises.

chunks.title: Hospital Metrics, Capacity & Accreditations
chunks.content: Key Changampally Institutional Metrics: Established in 1300 AD; 120 inpatient hospital beds; 24x7 emergency medical services; over 50 expert doctors and practitioners; 3 core specialties; 5 specialized centres across Kerala (Edappal, Peringode, Munnar, Thirunavaya); 14 specialized clinical departments with 33 sub-specializations. Changampally operates dedicated NABH-coordinated quality standards under certified research fellows and healthcare quality managers.

chunks.title: Department of Oncology & Cancer Rehabilitation
chunks.content: Changampally's Oncology Department adopts an integrated approach combining classical Ayurveda with conventional oncology to manage cancers and complex neoplastic disorders. Led by Chief Physician Dr. Jannathul Firdouse (30+ years experience, ex-NIMS Super Specialty Hospital), the department specializes in: Brain Tumors (e.g., Medulloblastoma, Glioma), Breast Cancer, Cervical Cancer, Ovarian Cancer, Lung Cancer, Bone Cancer, Skin Cancer, Gastrointestinal Cancer, Blood Cancer (Leukemia, Lymphoma), and Prostate Cancer. Treatments focus on scientific recovery, mitigating chemotherapy and radiation toxicities, alleviating cachexia, maintaining WBC and platelet counts, protecting organ vitality, and improving survival and quality of life.

chunks.title: Department of Neurology & Neurorehabilitation
chunks.content: The Neurology Department specializes in diagnosing and treating disorders of the central and peripheral nervous system (brain, spinal cord, and nerves). Conditions treated include: Post-Stroke Hemiplegia, Memory Disorders, Dementia, Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, Multiple Sclerosis (MS), Epilepsy, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), and Cerebral Palsy. Therapies integrate specialized Ayurvedic neuro-rejuvenative procedures (Shirodhara, Medicated Thalam, Njavarakizhi, Nasya) with modern physiotherapy and neuro-rehabilitation.

chunks.title: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology
chunks.content: Specializes in autoimmune diseases and chronic inflammatory disorders affecting joints, muscles, connective tissues, and immune function. Conditions treated include: Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA), Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus, Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, Hashimoto's Thyroiditis, Ankylosing Spondylitis, and Vasculitis. Treatment protocols cleanse circulating Ama (metabolic toxins), modulate immune response via Rasayana botanicals, and reduce pain without immunosuppressive toxicity.

chunks.title: Department of Endocrinology and Metabolism
chunks.content: Focuses on hormonal balances, metabolic health, and endocrine gland disorders. Conditions managed include: Type 1 and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Diabetic Neuropathy, Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS/PCOD), Metabolic Syndrome, Thyroid Disorders (Hypothyroidism, Hyperthyroidism, Goitre), Cushing's Syndrome, Adrenal Insufficiency, and Osteoporosis. Integrated protocols combine glycemic dietary management, classical Medohara formulations, panchakarma bio-purification, and lifestyle correction.

chunks.title: Department of Cardiology & Vascular Medicine
chunks.content: Treats cardiovascular and vascular system disorders with a focus on arterial health, microcirculation, and preventive cardiology. Conditions managed: Essential Hypertension (High Blood Pressure), Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) supportive care, Cardiac Arrhythmias (Atrial Fibrillation, Tachycardia), Dyslipidemia (High Cholesterol), and Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD). Therapies employ cardioprotective botanicals (such as Arjuna formulations), stress reduction through Shirodhara, and therapeutic lifestyle modifications.

chunks.title: Department of Gastroenterology & Hepatology
chunks.content: Focuses on diseases of the digestive tract and hepatobiliary system: esophagus, stomach, small intestine, colon, liver, gallbladder, and pancreas. Conditions treated: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), Crohn's Disease, Ulcerative Colitis, Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD / Acid Reflux), Alcoholic Liver Cirrhosis, Fatty Liver (NAFLD), Celiac Disease, Chronic Pancreatitis, and Peptic Ulcer Disease. Protocols restore Agni (digestive fire), repair mucosal barriers, and regulate gut microbiome.

chunks.title: Department of Psychiatry, Psychology & Happy Moon
chunks.content: Happy Moon is Changampally's dedicated Department of Happiness and Mental Wellbeing, led by MD Ayurvedic Psychiatrist Dr. Sajjad Changampally and clinical psychologists. Treats: Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD), Bipolar Disorder, Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD), Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Insomnia, Panic Attacks, and Nomophobia / Digital Dependence Syndrome. Therapies integrate Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Acceptance & Commitment Therapy (ACT), Smriti Meditation Therapy, Shirodhara, and Ashwagandha-based botanical protocols.

chunks.title: Department of Pulmonology & Respiratory Medicine
chunks.content: Specializes in diseases of the airways and respiratory tract. Conditions treated: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Bronchial Asthma, Chronic Bronchitis, Allergic Rhinitis, Sinusitis, and Post-viral Pulmonary Fibrosis. Treatments include classical Nasya (nasal administration), Dhoomapana (medicated herbal smoke), chest-clearing Kizhis, and Rasayanas that expand lung capacity and clear airway inflammation.

chunks.title: Department of Orthopedics, Spine & Musculoskeletal Health
chunks.content: Specializes in the diagnosis, non-surgical treatment, and rehabilitation of disorders affecting bones, joints, ligaments, tendons, and spine. Conditions treated: Osteoarthritis (Knee, Hip), Ankylosing Spondylitis, Cervical & Lumbar Spondylosis, Disc Prolapse / Herniation, Sciatica, Gouty Arthritis, Frozen Shoulder, and Chronic Back/Neck Pain. Interventions include Janu Basti, Kati Basti, Patra Pinda Sweda, Marma therapy, and non-surgical alignment.

chunks.title: Department of Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PM&R)
chunks.content: Led by Physiatrist Dr. Azhar Kalliyath (MBBS, DNB PM&R, FIPM), the PM&R department helps patients regain strength, mobility, and functional autonomy. Key units: Interventional Pain Management (ultrasound-guided blocks, regenerative medicine), Neurorehabilitation (post-stroke, spinal cord injury), Sports Injury Rehabilitation (ACL tears, meniscus injuries, rotator cuff tears), Critical Care Rehabilitation, and Post-surgical Orthopedic Rehabilitation.

chunks.title: Department of Dermatology & Chronic Diabetic Wound Care
chunks.content: Manages acute and chronic skin, hair, and nail disorders as well as complex wounds. Conditions treated: Psoriasis (plaque, guttate, scalp), Atopic Dermatitis (Eczema), Chronic Urticaria, Lichen Planus, Vitiligo, and Alopecia. The department operates a specialized Diabetic and Chronic Non-Healing Wound Care unit that combines modern antiseptic debridement with Ayurvedic formulations (Jatyadi, Murivenna) to stimulate tissue granulation and prevent amputations.

chunks.title: Department of Dental Oncology & Oral Health
chunks.content: Led by Dr. Najla Gurukkal (BDS), the Dental Oncology department delivers specialized oral health care for cancer patients. Focus areas: prevention and treatment of oral mucositis, osteoradionecrosis, xerostomia (dry mouth), and dental decay secondary to head and neck radiation or chemotherapy. It also delivers comprehensive family dentistry and preventive oral health.

chunks.title: Department of Ophthalmology & Vision Care
chunks.content: Focuses on the visual system and ocular health. Conditions treated: Refractive Errors (Myopia, Astigmatism), Glaucoma (Intraocular Pressure management), Inflammatory Eye Diseases (Uveitis, Blepharitis), Dry Eye Syndrome, and Retinitis Pigmentosa. Treatments use classical Netra Kriya Kalpas including Netra Tarpana (nourishing medicated ghee eye bath), Aschyotana, and Pindi.

chunks.title: Department of Hematology & Blood Health
chunks.content: Specializes in blood disorders and hematopoietic restoration. Conditions managed: Immune Thrombocytopenia (low platelet count), Chronic Anemia (iron deficiency, chronic illness anemia), and post-chemotherapy bone marrow suppression. Therapies combine iron-bioavailable Ayurvedic Bhasmas, Lohasavams, and bone-marrow stimulating Rasayanas.

chunks.title: Authentic Classical Panchakarma Procedures
chunks.content:
Classical Panchakarma at Changampally Vaidya Bhavan and Remedium follows strict classical protocol divided into three stages: 
1. Purva Karma (Preparatory): Snehana (internal oleation with medicated ghee like Ghritham) and Swedana (herbal steam sudation) to loosen toxins.
2. Pradhana Karma (The 5 Main Cleansing Procedures):
   - Vamana: Therapeutic emesis for Kapha disorders (asthma, psoriasis).
   - Virechana: Medicated purgation for Pitta disorders (liver, skin diseases).
   - Vasti (Anuvasana & Niruha): Medicated oil and decoction enemas for Vata disorders (neurological, arthritis, spine).
   - Nasya: Errhine therapy via nostrils for brain, neurological, sinusitis, and ENT disorders.
   - Raktamokshana: Bloodletting via leech therapy (Jalaukavacharana) for severe skin lesions and local inflammatory pooling.
3. Paschat Karma: Samsarjana Krama (graduated dietary resuscitation) to rebuild digestive fire (Agni).

chunks.title: Ayurvedic Oncology & Integrative Cancer Protocols
chunks.content:
Led by Dr. Jannathul Firdouse, Changampally's Cancer Rehabilitation program is designed to work in synergy with allopathic cancer care (chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery):
- Phase 1: Chemotherapy Support — mitigating nausea, vomiting, peripheral neuropathy, and mucosal ulcerations while preserving liver and renal parameters.
- Phase 2: Bone Marrow & Hematopoietic Support — natural protocols to counter neutropenia, anemia, and thrombocytopenia, enabling patients to complete planned chemo cycles without interruptions.
- Phase 3: Radiation Recovery — topical and systemic rasayanas for radiation dermatitis, internal fibrosis, and dry mouth.
- Phase 4: Long-Term Rehabilitation & Cachexia Reversal — restorative Rasayanas, herbal immuno-modulators, and nutrition to rebuild strength and minimize recurrence.

chunks.title: Research on Nomophobia, Cyber Psychology & Happy Moon
chunks.content: Dr. Sajjad Changampally and Dr. Shahna MT have conducted extensive clinical research in cyber psychology and smartphone addiction (Nomophobia). In a published study of college students evaluated with the validated Nomophobia Questionnaire (NMP-Q), daily smartphone usage exceeding 5 hours was directly correlated with anxiety and sleep architecture breakdown. Changampally's clinical trial evaluated an integrative protocol pairing Ashwagandha Churna with classical Satvavajaya Chikitsa (Ayurvedic psychotherapy), demonstrating statistically significant reductions on HAM-A (anxiety), HAM-D (depression), and NMP-Q scales. This protocol is now practiced through Happy Moon at CRIH.

chunks.title: How to Reach Changampally Remedium & Travel Guide
chunks.content:
Location: Changampally Remedium is situated in Kandanakam, Edappal in Malappuram district, Kerala. 
Travel Options:
- By Train: Nearest railway stations are Kuttippuram Railway Station (KTU, ~12 km / 20 mins drive) and Tirur Railway Station (TIR, ~28 km / 45 mins drive), with frequent express trains connecting Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, and Chennai.

- By Road: Edappal is well connected via NH 66 and state highways connecting Thrissur, Palakkad, and Kozhikode. Hospital transport and airport pick-up can be arranged upon request.
